description: This PHP class defines a report plugin for the Revive Adserver, specifically generating a 'Live Campaign Delivery' report. It includes methods for initializing report info, retrieving default parameters, executing report generation, and processing campaign delivery data, including calculations for delivery performance and misdelivery metrics.

classes.name: Plugins_Reports_OxReportsStandard_LiveCampaignDeliveryReport
classes.description: A PHP class for generating a detailed campaign delivery report within the Revive Adserver platform, including data retrieval, processing, and report creation functionalities.

methods.name: initInfo
methods.description: Initializes report metadata such as name, description, category, author, export format, and authorizations.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default report parameters based on user session preferences.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves user-selected report parameters into session preferences.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Generates the report by preparing data, creating worksheets, and outputting the report file.

methods.name: _getReportParametersForDisplay
methods.description: Returns displayable report parameters, combining scope and date range info.

methods.name: _addSummaryWorksheet
methods.description: Creates and adds the campaign delivery performance worksheet to the report.

methods.name: _getDeliveryPerformanceData
methods.description: Retrieves and merges campaign delivery data for the report period, yesterday, and today.

methods.name: _getDeliveryPerformanceDataRange
methods.description: Fetches raw delivery data for a specified date range and scope from the database.

methods.name: _mergeDeliveryPerformanceData
methods.description: Combines overall, yesterday, and today data, adding hourly impressions and matching campaigns.

methods.name: _findMatchingCampaignData
methods.description: Finds campaign data in an array by campaign ID.

methods.name: _prepareDeliveryPerformanceData
methods.description: Formats raw data into display-ready rows, including calculations for delivery percentages and status labels.

methods.name: _calculateCampaignType
methods.description: Determines if a campaign is 'Targeted' or 'Run of Site' based on targeting data.

methods.name: _decodeStatusDescription
methods.description: Converts campaign active status code into human-readable string.

methods.name: _decodePriority
methods.description: Converts campaign priority code into descriptive string.

methods.name: _formatDateForDisplay
methods.description: Formats date strings into the user’s preferred display format.

methods.name: _calculateCompletionPercentage
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of booked impressions delivered.

methods.name: _calculateOverallMisdelivery
methods.description: Estimates how much a campaign is over- or under-delivering over its lifetime.

methods.name: _calculateTodaysMisdelivery
methods.description: Estimates misdelivery based on today's data and campaign schedule.

methods.name: _rangeFromCampaign
methods.description: Creates a date span object from campaign start and end dates.

methods.name: _calculateOverallPercentDifference
methods.description: Calculates difference between actual and expected delivery percentages.

methods.name: _calculateTodaysPercentDifference
methods.description: Estimates final delivery discrepancy based on today's impressions and schedule.
